Na Ukrajině zadržela policie nezletilou dívku, která na pokyn ruského kurátora otrávila dva ukrajinské vojáky. Poslala jim poštou omamné látky, které obsahovaly smrtelné množství metadonu.
Článek
Policie zadržela v Žytomyrské oblasti sedmnáctiletou dívku, která podle vyšetřování pomáhala ruské tajné službě FSB trávit ukrajinské vojáky. Informovala o tom ukrajinská policie na telegramu. Dívka podle ní na pokyn ruského kurátora balila omamné látky a posílala je vojákům poštou. Dva vojáci po jejich užití zemřeli.
Organizátoři kontaktovali vojáky prostřednictvím telegramu a nabízeli jim drogy zdarma. Dívka na balíčcích uváděla fiktivní údaje o odesílateli. Když vojáci zásilky převzali, dostali pokyn, aby drogu užili před kamerou. V kapslích však bylo obsaženo smrtelné množství metadonu. Dívce byla za spolupráci přislíbena odměna 5000 hřiven (asi 2400 korun), uvedla policie.

shrnuti: Russian forces attacked Vilniansk in Zaporizhzhia Oblast on 23 October, destroying a house, damaging surrounding homes and injuring two residents.

Source: Mykhailo Semikin , acting head of Zaporizhzhia Oblast Military Administration; regional media outlet Suspilne Zaporizhzhia
Quote from Semikin: "The enemy attacked Vilniansk. The strike hit a house. The residence is partially destroyed and nearby houses are also damaged."
Advertisement:

Firefighters have already extinguished the fire.

Good morning. I’m Mared Gwyn. In this Friday edition: Ursula von der Leyen is set to become a headline act at Hungary’s 1956 revolution commemoration, and Europeans grapple with Trump’s “terrifying” Ukraine approach.
Brussels-Budapest reset: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen and European Council President António Costa will join a commemoration of the 70th anniversary of Hungary’s 1956 anti-Soviet uprising in Budapest today, with von der Leyen expected to deliver a speech in parliament alongside Prime Minister Péter Magyar. It’s arguably one of the clearest signals yet of the new chapter in EU-Hungary relations, our Hungarian correspondent Sándor Zsiros writes this morning.

Russian forces launched a massive attack on one of DTEK’s thermal power plants, forcing it to halt electricity generation.
The DTEK Group reported this on Telegram , according to Ukrinform.

shrnuti: Officers from Poland’s Internal Security Agency have detained a 22-year-old Georgian citizen in connection with the murder of Russian performance artist Semyon Skrepetsky, said Tomasz Siemoniak, the coordinator of Poland’s intelligence services.

Poland detains second suspect in murder of Russian artist and Putin critic Semyon Skrepetsky
October 22, 2026, 5:56 pm
Source: RMF24
Officers from Poland’s Internal Security Agency have detained a 22-year-old Georgian citizen in connection with the murder of Russian performance artist Semyon Skrepetsky, said Tomasz Siemoniak, the coordinator of Poland’s intelligence services.
RMF24 identified the man as Makhmud A. The outlet reported that he helped the suspected killer, who had been detained earlier, by keeping Skrepetsky’s home under surveillance and gathering information about his habits.
Makhmud A. arrived in Poland the day before he was detained and was traveling with two other Georgian citizens. The other two were expelled from the country, RMF24 reported.
Makhmud A. was charged with aiding and abetting murder and illegally possessing weapons and ammunition. He denied the charges.
Russian performance artist Semyon Skrepetsky was killed on June 15 in the Polish city of Biała Podlaska. The first suspect in his murder was detained near Warsaw on June 18.…

Ruská tajná služba FSB zveřejnila v dubnu 2025 záběry, na kterých agenti v Soči zatýkají Rumuna podezřelého ze špionáže pro Ukrajinu. Agentura Reuters zjistila, že scéna vznikla v době, kdy byl muž už 4 měsíce ve vazbě.
Článek
Mladý muž v tmavě modré čepici s batohem na zádech jde parkem. Z dodávky vyskočí dva agenti a srazí ho na chodník. Jeden z nich mu otočí obličej ke kameře a anglicky se ho zeptá, jak se jmenuje. „David Adrian Kercso,“ odpoví zadržený. „Odkud jsi?“ „Z Rumunska.“
FSB k videu tehdy oznámila, že v Soči dopadla rumunského občana, který podle nich vynášel Ukrajincům informace o ruské protivzdušné obraně. Kercso, který vyrůstal v Anglii, dostal letos od krajského soudu v Krasnodaru 15 let vězení za špionáž. Proti rozhodnutí soudu se plánuje odvolat.

Článek

Video s útokem zveřejnil facebookový profil NEoficiální Krnov - oficiální drby II . „Na videu je můj syn, který se jel zastat třináctiletého kluka, kterého pán, který evidentně nemá všech pět pohromadě, napadal,“ stojí v diskusi pod příspěvkem. „Zelenskyj nechce tuto válku ukončit, pravděpodobně nikdy nechtěl,“ prohlásil na začátku týdne americký prezident Donald Trump na adresu svého ukrajinského protějšku. Nebyla to zdaleka jediná poznámka, kterou zpochybnil snahy Kyjeva vyjednat mír.

V Kyjevě zasáhly ve čtvrtek v časných ranních hodinách rakety, uvedl svědek agentury Reuters . Jedná se o další útok na ukrajinské hlavní město, který následoval po večerním ruském leteckém úderu, při kterém bylo zraněno šest lidí.
Při předchozím útoku byla v Dniprovském obvodu poškozena autoservisní stanice a soukromý obytný dům, informoval starosta Vitalij Kličko. Dodal, že pod sutinami mohou být uvězněni lidé.

Putin releases U.S. citizen Stephen Hubbard, who fought on Ukraine’s side
October 21, 2026, 9:42 am
Source: TASS
Russian President Vladimir Putin said U.S. citizen Stephen Hubbard, who fought on Ukraine’s side and was convicted by a Russian court of mercenary activity, has been released. Putin made the announcement at the start of a meeting with U.S. presidential envoy Steve Witkoff.
Hubbard is already at Pulkovo Airport in St. Petersburg, Putin said.
Hubbard, who was 72 at the time, was sentenced in Russia in October 2024 to six years and 10 months in prison on mercenary charges. In the first days of Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, Hubbard joined the territorial defense in the Kharkiv region, where he had lived for many years, and in April 2022 he was captured by Russian forces.
The New York Times reported the day before that Witkoff would try to secure Hubbard’s release during his trip to Russia in order to “to show the benefits of deal-making” with Putin.

Skip to main content
Russia’s FSB says it detained German citizen who fought for Ukraine
October 21, 2026, 9:13 am
Source: Interfax
Russia’s Federal Security Service (FSB) said Russian law enforcement authorities detained a German citizen who allegedly signed a contract with the Ukrainian army and deserted.
The man arrived in Ukraine in November 2025 and signed a three-year contract to serve in the Ukrainian armed forces, the agency said, but deserted because he had not received the money he had been promised.
The FSB did not say how he ended up in Russia. A criminal case has been opened against him on charges of mercenary activity.
According to the FSB, the man took part in combat operations in Afghanistan as part of the German contingent from 2004 to 2010. He also fought in the armed conflict in Somalia from 2006 to 2008, served as a mercenary in Syria from 2008 to 2010, and fought in eastern Ukraine on the side of the Ukrainian armed forces from 2016 to 2018, the agency said.

It is planned to introduce the State Defence Service (VAD) into the State Border Guard from 2028, as announced by Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs (United List) following a conceptual decision taken during the closed part of Tuesday’s cabinet meeting, LSM.lv reports.
It is envisaged that the Ministry of the Interior will collaborate with the Ministry of Defence on the introduction of the VAD within the Border Guard, including the resources actually required and the additional financial resources needed by each of the institutions involved.
The state budget bill will consider the additional funding required to introduce the VAD within the Border Guard, in accordance with the state budget’s financial capacity.

UK police said Tuesday they have re-arrested two men on suspicion of spying for Iran, amid an investigation into a security scare at a British airbase used by the United States.
Counter-terrorism police said a 24-year-old British citizen and a 25-year-old UK-Iranian dual national, both from London, were arrested "on suspicion of assisting a foreign intelligence service" over last month's incident at the Fairford base in southwest England.
"The country to which the investigation relates is Iran," the police statement said.
The United States abruptly withdrew all its B-1 bombers from the Royal Air Force (RAF) site earlier this month after the incident there on September 27.
Prime Minister Andy Burnham has said Iran's Revolutionary Guards "almost certainly directed" the major scare, which remained shrouded in mystery and speculation.

Ruská FSB zatkla reportéra severojaponského deníku Hokkaidó Šimbun na Sachalinu a obvinila ho ze špionáže. Tokio rozhořčilo, že Moskva jeho diplomatům brání v přístupu k vězněnému.
Více o poslechu Deníku N
Přidat Deník N mezi oblíbené zdroje
Za mřížemi klece pro obžalované vypadal jako kterýkoli ruský občan předvolaný před lefortovský obvodní soud v Moskvě. Tím spíš, že mu ruská zpravodajská služba FSB, která ho před soud dostala, rozmazala na snímcích ze soudní síně obličej.
Jenže potíž je, že 14. října v Lefortovu nestál ruský občan. Za soudními mřížemi se totiž ocitl Japonec, konkrétně reportér japonských novin Hokkaidó Šimbun, které, jak napovídá už jejich název, působí hlavně na severojaponském ostrově Hokkaidó.
Ale nejen tam. Dotyčný novinář totiž svou pracovní základnu nemá v hokkaidském ústředním městě Sapporu, ale v bezmála 500 kilometrů vzdáleném Južno-Sachalinsku, což znamená v Rusku.
A právě do Južno-Sachalinsku si pro dotyčného reportéra…

Všechno je jednou poprvé, i zásah slzným plynem. Pokud jste se 17. října zrovna nalézali v Paříži, šance, že se vám to stane, byla poměrně značná. Plakáty, jimiž byly polepené ulice východní části města, ten den nazývaly „Revolucí 17. října“.

Authorities in Kazakhstan have dropped drug smuggling charges against popular Russian hip-hop artist Navai and deported him from the country, local police said Tuesday.

Off Hiiumaa island, German warship wrecks from 1916 are ticking ecological time bombs, holding thousands of liters of oil that could pollute Baltic Sea coastlines if released.
The German torpedo boats S57 , V72 and V75 sank in November 1916 after straying into a minefield during a failed attack on the port of Paldiski.
A new study by researchers from the Estonian Maritime Museum (EMM) and Finland, led by Ivar Treffner, assessed the wrecks and the environmental threat they pose.
At the time, navies had only just begun transitioning from coal to liquid fuel. The ships went down carrying thousands of liters of heavy fuel oil, which remains trapped inside their hulls today.

titulekPuvodni: "A wonderful teacher": the woman killed with her baby daughter in Nova Vodolaha
shrnuti: A Russian drone attack on a Kharkiv Oblast park has killed six people, including teacher Inna Mariukhna and her one-year-old daughter Anhelina.

vyrez.text:
Russian strike on Nova Vodolaha park kills primary school teacher and her toddler | Ukrainska Pravda
The strike on the park in Nova Vodolaha killed two children and four adults. Photo: Nova Vodolaha School / Facebook
On 19 October, Inna Mariukhna and her one-year-old daughter Anhelina were killed in a Russian attack on Nova Vodolaha in Kharkiv Oblast. Inna taught primary school pupils at the local school.
Source: Inna's colleagues from Nova Vodolaha School No. 1
Quote from the school: "No words can convey the despair of this irreparable loss. It is hard to believe that two lives have been cut short, extinguishing dreams and hopes that should have been fulfilled and flourishing.
Advertisement:





Inna Mariukhna was a wonderful teacher who opened up the world of knowledge to little ones, taught them their first steps in life, and gave the children all the warmth of her heart. Her kindness, sincerity and professionalism will forever live in the memory of her colleagues and pupils. It is heartbreaking that her little daughter Anhelina died with her."
Background:

titulek: Russians attack superstore in Kovel
titulekPuvodni: Russians attack superstore in Kovel
shrnuti: Volyn Oblast authorities have confirmed overnight attacks targeted civilian and power infrastructure, causing localised power outages and damaging commercial facilities in Kovel.

vyrez.text:
Russian drone strike damages superstore and energy infrastructure in Kovel | Ukrainska Pravda
A damaged superstore. Stock photo: National Police
The Russians attacked Volyn Oblast using jet-powered Shahed drones on the night of 19-20 October, resulting in damage to energy facilities and businesses.
Source: Roman Romaniuk , Head of Volyn Oblast Military Administration
Quote: "Just like in previous days, the enemy continues to target electric power facilities and civil infrastructure. Kovel suffered the most attacks last night."
Advertisement:





Details: A car repair shop and a parking lot for lorries have been damaged.
An impact was recorded on the territory of the Epicentr home improvement superstore, where warehouse facilities were damaged. There are no fatalities or injuries.
Power outages occurred across the region during the night, but as of the morning of 20 October, almost all of Volyn Oblast has electricity. Only a few settlements in the Lutsk district remain without power.
Background: On the night of 19-20 October, energy infrastructure facilities were damaged as a result of a Russian attack on Odesa Oblast.

titulek: Ukraine's air defence downs 115 out of 165 Russian drones, with 20 still airborne
titulekPuvodni: Ukraine's air defence downs 115 out of 165 Russian drones, with 20 still airborne
shrnuti: Russia launched 165 drones, including 105 jet-powered UAVs. Ukraine's Air Force reported hits at 30 locations and falling drone debris at another 13.

vyrez.text:
Ukraine destroys or jams 115 out of 165 Russian drones overnight | Ukrainska Pravda
A total of 115 drones were downed overnight. Infographic: Ukraine's Air Force
Russia attacked Ukraine with 165 drones (105 jet-powered) on the night of 19-20 October. Ukraine's air defence has destroyed or jammed 115 UAVs, while another 20 remain airborne.
Source: Ukraine's Air Force
Details: The attack began at 18:00 on 19 October. Russian forces used Shahed and Gerbera attack drones, S-8000 Banderol/Dan-T drone- and air-launched cruise missiles and Parodiya decoy UAVs.
Advertisement:





The drones were launched from the Russian cities of Oryol, Kursk and Primorsko-Akhtarsk as well as from temporarily occupied Donetsk, Chauda and Hvardiiske (Crimea) and from the Sea of Azov.
Quote: "As of 08:00, [Ukrainian] air defence forces had destroyed or jammed 115 Shahed (73 jet-powered), Gerbera and other types of drones. Another 20 attack drones remain airborne,
Hits by aerial assets have been recorded at 30 locations and the fall of downed aerial assets (debris) at 13 locations."

For now there might be a copy or two of Intermezzo left kicking around in your local bookshop – snap it up if you haven’t already, because soon that will be it.
Last year, Sally Rooney said she would be using her royalties to support Palestine Action , a group that is proscribed as a terrorist organisation under UK law. Since then, thousands of people have been arrested for supporting the group. Now, faced with the risk of prosecution under terrorism legislation, Rooney and her publishers have decided to stop supplying her books to retailers in the UK.
Over the weekend, hundreds of authors signed an open letter supporting her. The rightwing press, meanwhile, have called Rooney a “tedious and malicious” “posturing ingrate”.

Engineers have removed the masts of the SS Richard Montgomery – a second world war cargo ship that sank in 1944 with approximately 1,400 tonnes of munitions onboard – without triggering the kind of feared explosion that has kept the wreck under constant guard for decades.

Prezident Petr Pavel
Článek
Že se prezident schůzky zúčastní, uvedl Hrad v krátké tiskové zprávě. Hlava státu se může rady zúčastnit ze zákona. Prezident republiky má právo účastnit se schůzí Bezpečnostní rady státu, vyžadovat od ní a jejích členů zprávy a projednávat s ní nebo jejími členy otázky, které patří do jejich působnosti.

Bezpečnostní radu státu tvoří předseda vlády a další členové vlády podle rozhodnutí kabinetu.

Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni is poised to approve emergency security measures, according to local media, after protests over rising costs broke out into violent clashes in Milan.
The measures include extending preventative detention to minors and restricting group gatherings, Milanese paper Corriere della Sera reported.
Police deployed tear gas and water cannons after protesters - many in masks - threw paving stones, bins and chairs at officers over the weekend. More than 250 people were detained, 80% of whom were minors, Italian police said.
The expected crackdown comes after Meloni chaired an emergency security meeting on Monday afternoon. No official announcements have been made.

In August, a sabotage attempt took place at Leipzig Airport in Germany, which the German government has said was carried out by Russia. One of the suspected organizers of the attack is a Latvian citizen by the name of Oļegs Ļevuškins (Oleg Levushkin).
The Latvian Television programme investigative programme De Facto revealed on October 18th that Levushkin had been in business in Russia for almost 18 years as the owner of a Latvian pharmaceutical company called "Elpis".
The State Security Service (VDD) confirmed to De Facto that it has already initiated the procedure to revoke Levushkin's Latvian citizenship.
Leipzig Airport is one of the main routes for delivering military aid to Ukraine. On the evening of August 4 this year, a drone crashed into the wing of a Ukrainian cargo plane there, very close to its fuel tank. The drone contained explosives, but the detonator did not go off.…

Litva vyšetruje pokus o podpaľačský útok na objekt so zariadením Starlink. Premiér ho označil za súčasť ruskej hybridnej vojny.
V Litve zaznamenali v noci na nedeľu pokus o podpaľačský útok na objekt spoločnosti, v ktorom sa nachádza zariadenie amerického satelitného komunikačného systému Starlink. Oznámil to v nedeľu vo verejnoprávnom médiu LRT litovský premiér Mindaugas Sinkevičius, podľa ktorého tento „pokus o sabotáž“ je „jednoznačne súčasťou ruskej hybridnej vojny“. Informovala o tom agentúra AFP, píše TASR.
V priestoroch bližšie nešpecifikovanej spoločnosti, kde sa nachádza deväť satelitných antén zabezpečujúcich pripojenie cez systém Starlink, ktorý využíva aj ukrajinská armáda, a riadiace stredisko, sa podľa premiéra našla horľavá látka – tzv. urýchľovač horenia.
